en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Asbat, from Dawood Bin Al Na’man, from Abu Ubeyda who said,
‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, and he<sup>asws</sup> saw the people at Makkah and what they were doing. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Their deeds are like the deeds of the Pre-Islamic period.
But, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, they have not been Commanded with this, and they have not been Commanded with except that they should complete their Hajj, and let them fulfil their vows.
Then they should pass by us<sup>asws</sup> and they should inform us<sup>asws</sup> of their Wilayah and present their help to us<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 2. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Asbat from Dawud ibn al-Ni‘man from abu ‘Ubayda who has said the following.
“I heard abu Ja‘far say, (a.s.) when he saw people in Makka and what they were doing, “Activities like those in the days of ignorance.
By Allah, they are not commanded to do as suCh
What they are commanded to do is to complete their Hajj, relieve themselves of the obligations of vows and visit us to inform us of their support and express their help before us.”
